evidence.text: Glue quivers A and B using arrows only from A to B and choose arg Z(A)<arg Z(B). Mixed-support representations then have destabilizing B subrepresentations, leaving the union of the finite spectra. The quiver rule does not require completeness. Iterated augmented-triangulation gluing additionally requires a suitable chamber with no bound state using a chosen attachment node more than once.

evidence.text: The reviewed quiver dictionary studies four-supercharge quantum mechanics with gauge group ∏U(n_i). Charge-γ states come from F-flat, Π-stable representations modulo ∏GL(n_i,C); every proper nonzero subrepresentation S must satisfy arg Z(S)<arg Z(R). Cohomology determines spin: a point yields a hypermultiplet and P¹ a vector multiplet.

evidence.text: Setting α=α̂=0 while retaining logarithmic five-brane sources removes the two asymptotic AdS₅×S⁵ regions. Local coordinate expansions establish smooth caps homeomorphic to AdS₄×B₆, locally AdS₄×R⁶.

evidence.text: Gauge the fibre coordinate through dψ→dψ+A and deform the four-form flux, then substitute into the eleven-dimensional equations. Projected gravitino variations supply the fermionic extension. Thermal observables are imported through charged-black-hole thermodynamics and stress-tensor Kubo analysis.

sources.title: Holographic Duals of D=3 N=4 Superconformal Field Theories

evidence.text: Flux integration and Page-charge quantization give linking numbers in terms of f(x)=2 arctan(eˣ)/π. The partition inequalities are reduced to sums whose strict positivity follows from 0<f(x)<1 at finite x.
